verdict.rationale: GlitchTip says it 'aims to be Sentry API compatible', and it offers some programmatic surfaces: a built-in MCP server that can browse, inspect and resolve issues, and a CLI for releases, deploys, debug files and source maps. Nothing in the evidence shows UI-to-API parity, though. Org, team, project and alert-recipient setup are documented only as UI steps, and no OpenAPI spec could be found at any probed path. Missing for 10: documented API reference or OpenAPI spec, evidence that admin and config actions (orgs, teams, projects, alerts, uptime monitors) are exposed via API, independent confirmation of the Sentry API compatibility claim.
